concerns.text: The plan maps FR-009 (baseline incremental‑capacity) to src/model/baseline.py, but FR-009 is not defined in the specification (spec.md). This is an over‑reach beyond the required functional requirements.
The plan maps FR-010 (normalization statistics from cycles 1‑50) to src/data/preprocess.py, yet FR-010 does not exist in the spec. This adds a requirement that the spec never asked for.

The plan maps FR-013 (contract validation) to contracts/*.yaml, but FR-013 is absent from the spec. Contract testing is already covered by FR-013 in the spec’s success‑criteria, so this entry is redundant.

The plan maps FR-014 (post‑hoc power analysis) to src/model/evaluate.py, yet FR-014 is not listed in the spec. Power analysis is only mentioned in the success criteria (SC‑011) and does not constitute a separate functional requirement.
